title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-01-02
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT (x) > CDR (x) > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard recording of a truncated show highlighted by an epic Dark Star, stellar St. Stephen, rousing Eleven and soaring Lovelight.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this partial 1970 performance, calling the Dark Star one of the greatest ever and praising the powerful St. Stephen, the enthusiastic Eleven and the fiery Lovelight. The soundboard source is described as crisp and front‑loaded with cymbals, organ and guitar, with only minor hiss and a tiny cut in St. Stephen that doesn’t detract from the overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 20 reviews, most giving 5‑star ratings and extolling both musical performance and audio fidelity; recording is consistently called superb and the show is repeatedly labeled a top‑tier Dark Star outing.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with cymbals, snare and organ right up front; occasional tape hiss and a brief cut in St. Stephen noted but not detrimental.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a fragment of the full concert (Dark Star → St. Stephen → Lovelight, plus The Eleven) survives, yet the sequence flows brilliantly and delivers 50 minutes of pure Dead magic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his soaring, melodic lead work in Dark Star and a perfect guitar tone.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig Pen’s organ on Lovelight and Dark Star is highlighted; several reviewers discuss the presence of Tom Constanten (TC) versus Pig Pen during Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Drums: Cymbals, snare and overall drum presence are described as front‑and‑center and exceptionally clear.
